description: States grocery-atlas hero: one static composite (backdrop, seated mascot with red thumbtack, atlas, tabletop, avocado dish, vegetable crate, lemons, cloth, tomatoes) cut from the founder-approved reference by deterministic crop + alpha. Prepared for review; NOT imported by the app. Nothing was regenerated, resampled, recoloured, sharpened or repaired; no pixel was synthesised.
status: Founder visual approval received 2026-09-30. Imported by the States step only (src/components/onboarding/states-step.tsx); the production bytes are unchanged from the export.

measuredPage.referenceCreamNoise: Rows 545-599 (between the body copy and the backdrop), full width: mode (254,253,250); max-channel |C - cream| <= 5, mostly <= 3.
measuredPage.note: The exterior is keyed to transparent, so on screen the page token itself shows through; edges are unmatted against the MEASURED reference cream (the colour the art was actually blended with), not the token. The token is 1-4 units darker than the reference cream.

resolution: Native reference pixels (853px-wide mock). No upscaling; the export carries no more detail than the approved screenshot.

cropDecisions.top: Backdrop solid top (max-channel deviation from cream > 24) is row 605 at x~650-700; its antialiasing starts at row 602. Top 597 = 605 - 8 (the Welcome convention), clear of the body copy (ends ~505). The manifest's 605 would have clipped the edge antialiasing at the backdrop's highest point.
cropDecisions.bottom: The native search border's line is rows 1329-1330 (x 58-794) with its antialiasing already in row 1328 (mean blue-minus-red +6.5 vs -6.1 in row 1327 over x 300-499). Row 1327 is the last border-free row, so the crop ends at 1328 (exclusive), 2 rows below the suggestion. The border's rounded corners (x 44-61 and 792-809) lie entirely at rows >= 1329.
cropDecisions.sides: Full width 0-852: backdrop, avocado dish, crate/vegetables, atlas, lemons, cloth and tomatoes run off both edges in the approved frame and keep those crops; no content invented beyond the frame.
cropDecisions.lowestObjects: Tomatoes (red-dominant) end at row 1280; lemons (yellow) at 1202; the cloth hem shadow reaches the left page edge by row 1315. Mascot feet, atlas and crate end well above.

operations.sourceExport: Rectangular crop of the reference; RGB samples copied unchanged (verified 0 differing samples); re-encoded losslessly as 8-bit RGB with explicit sRGB/gAMA/cHRM; the caBX export chunk dropped; no ICC, bKGD, tIME or text chunks.
operations.exteriorKey: Welcome export's key, unchanged: flood from the crop's top row through every pixel that is not solid art (max-channel deviation from the measured cream > 24), never below reference row 700. Flooded pixels within 3 of the cream: alpha 0. Flooded pixels above that and solid pixels within 3px of the exterior: alpha = projection of (C - cream) onto (F - cream), F = the nearest interior art pixel within 6px; RGB unmatted as cream + (C - cream) / alpha. A flooded pixel with no coloured art within 6px is cleared (all such pixels were page noise, deviation <= 5).

exteriorFloodResult.note: The flood stops at the backdrop's edge; it meets the left page edge at row ~681 and never reaches the mascot, atlas or any object.

operations.nearOpaqueLift: Existing contract: alpha 240-254 set to 255 with the SOURCE RGB (not unmatted).
operations.lowerFade: Rows 1316-1327 (reference): alpha multiplied by a smoothstep from 1 to 0 over 12 rows; RGB left ORIGINAL (a compositing ramp, not a matte). These rows are counter-to-page vignette only: across x 60-799 they are within ~40 units (mean ~5-15) of the cream; no object reaches them.
operations.tooling: Pure Node (zlib PNG decode/encode, no canvas colour management) for pixels; @napi-rs/canvas (already a devDependency) only to lay out the comparison sheet. No dependency added. Scripts lived in the session scratchpad, as for Welcome.
operations.textRemoval: None needed: no baked text crosses rows 597-1327.

files.role: review sheet: A exact crop / B on background/page / C on dark #1E2433 / D alpha / E reference / F full-screen reconstruction / G lower edge 2x

protectedPixelFidelity: Every alpha-255 pixel (591072) is RGB byte-identical to the exact crop. Rows 682-1315 (mascot, thumbtack, rays, atlas, avocado dish, crate, vegetables, lemons, cloth, tomatoes, table) are 100% alpha 255. Non-opaque pixels exist only in the exterior above the backdrop edge (lowest row 681, where the backdrop meets the left page edge) and in the fade rows 1316-1327.
limitations: Left-corner fade: at x < 60 the table vignette is ~30 units from cream at row 1327 and, in the reference, finishes fading beside the search field by ~row 1338. Those rows cannot be included without the search border, so the export completes that fade within rows 1316-1327; composited on the reference cream the corner is up to 35 units lighter than the reference in those 12 rows (x 60-799: up to 27; x 800-852: up to 13). Above row 1316 nothing differs by more than the page noise.

The lower band is the original counter-to-page gradient, which is cream by design: on a non-cream surface (sheet panel C) it shows as a light band before the alpha reaches 0. The asset is intended for background/page.

Backdrop edge pixels with very low alpha (1-15) carry unmatted RGB that drifts toward saturated cyan (e.g. 127/255/255 at alpha 2); their weight is <= 6%, so no halo is visible on cream or dark (inspected at 4-5x on #1E2433).
The mock is 853px wide. The export is a native-resolution crop; it cannot be sharper than the approved screenshot.

artContract.atlas: Static, generic, uniformly blue; no California marker, no selected-state fill, no location layer added.
artContract.thumbtack: Red thumbtack stays in the mascot's hand, original pixels.
artContract.mascot: Exact approved pixels; not split out.

runtime: Only the production scene is imported, by src/components/onboarding/states-step.tsx. The reference, source, report and comparison files must never be bundled.

revisions.change: Founder approved the export; imported by the States step. No pixel changed.
